name: TanStack Start (confidential)
description: Authorization Code with a client_secret kept server-side. For apps that have a backend.

variables.label: OAuth issuer base URL
variables.help: The SDK appends /oauth2/authorize and /oauth2/token to this value. Point it at the auth base, NOT the bare host (the bare host 404s — endpoints live under /api/auth).

variables.label: Model Match REST API base URL
OAuth client secret
variables.help: NEVER prefix this with VITE_ — it must never reach the browser bundle.

variables.label: OAuth redirect URI
variables.help: Must exactly match the redirect URI registered with your OAuth app.
